text: I'm looking for a boutique hotel for a couple, three nights in May, mid-range in Lisbon. Which hotels would you recommend? Please name specific ones.

google.method: Google Maps result list (maps.google.com/maps/search, English UI, browser in Israel); sponsored entries skipped; list order kept

google_only.name: 262 Boutique Hotel
lift: Quality bar first: under 4.3★ or fewer than 20 reviews we do not promote a business. Earn the reviews; the rest follows.
Be where the engines read for this question: they cite Business sites, Reviews & directories, Google. A page about you on those sources is what gets a name into the answer.
Make your own site readable to an engine: a plain text description of what you do, where, for whom, with prices and opening hours in the HTML (not only in images).
One consistent name, address and phone everywhere the engines look (Google, directories, your site), so the mentions add up to one business.
Re-measure: we ask the same question again on every engine and show the change, run by run.
